resources.chapterTitle: Building a CI/CD Pipeline for a Data Project
resources.title: GitHub Actions Workflow Template for a dbt Project
resources.description: A complete, two-job `.github/workflows/ci.yml` template matching the course's own `retail-orders-analytics` project — a pull-request build-and-test job targeting a disposable CI schema, and a separate merge-to-main deploy job targeting production, gated by the exact `if:` conditions from Lessons 20-22. Copy it, rename the project and schemas, and it's ready to commit.

resources.chapterTitle: Building a CI/CD Pipeline for a Data Project
resources.title: Workflow Failure Reading Checklist
resources.description: A step-by-step method for reading a failed GitHub Actions run: where to find the first red line in the log, how to distinguish a YAML syntax error (the workflow never starts) from a step failure (the workflow starts but one step fails) from a job-condition mismatch (the job you expected to run didn't), and the specific `if:` conditions this course's own CI/deploy split depends on getting right.

resources.chapterTitle: Building a CI/CD Pipeline for a Data Project
resources.title: CI/Production Secrets Separation Checklist
resources.description: Lesson 23's least-privilege reasoning (separate CI and production credentials, fork PRs withheld from secrets, automatic log masking) as a real pre-launch checklist — confirm these before a CI/CD pipeline ever touches a credential with real access.

resources.title: Data Project Review Rubric
resources.description: A five-dimension rubric (correctness, testing, documentation, performance awareness, maintainability) for reviewing a finished CI/CD pipeline and the project it builds, against a real professional standard. Shared across the Analytics Engineer path's courses.
